items.context: @MetaMask (1.417.122 seguidores), en inglés, sin imagen: "Self-custody isn't a feature.. it's the point." Publicado hace ~10 min: 51 likes, 13 respuestas, 8.089 vistas. Tema custodia (autocustodia).
items.suggested_text:
Agreed, and it's worth being precise about what "the point" actually means. Self-custody isn't only holding your own keys; it's controlling every place those keys could leak. A browser extension, a phone, even a hardware wallet: each is a layer you're trusting, and each category has had its failures, from fake extensions and wallet drainers to address poisoning and tampered devices.

The strongest setups remove layers instead of adding them: keys generated offline, never touching a connected machine, plus an inheritance plan your family can actually carry out.

Holding the keys is step one. Knowing everything that could still touch them is where custody really starts. https://x.com/ForecastQuant/status/2123585216740528526
